My favorite card this expansion has been Evolve by far. It's not a win condition card, though it certainly can be if you get lucky. It's very satisfying to have some garbage minion turn in to the legendary that wins you the game. Though it can also be very frustrating when your card actually gets downgraded (do NOT evolve your flamewreathed faceless). Load up your board. Hit that evolve. Laugh (or cry).

My least favorite card, at least to get pulled on me is C'thun's Chosen. A 4/2 that takes a minimum of 2 cards to remove without wasting a hard removal like hex or poly. Very difficult and annoying to trade with. I hate this card.

What are some of yours?
Now that the expansion has been out for over a month, what is your favorite card of the new expansion and what is your least favorite?

I dislike most standard c'thun decks just because of how boring it is to see them over and over again. I don't hate c'thun as a concept, but in reality it becomes more annoying than the gimmick is worth.

My favorite might be servant of yogg just because it almost always fucks up the person who played it. Gives some entertainment value to the game every time.

The problem with it I see is that it kind of gets a new player to try to shoe horn that in to every single deck. A friend of mine just started playing and hes since then made like 6 different decks that are all C'thun.

For me, the cards that I like are the ones that are consistently useful and solid overall, without being overpowered. Cards such as shadow strike for rogue and stormcrack for shaman.
